summary: Pass the actual R19 swapchain owner through R24 projection/direct-flat RenderTo calls so Draw records GPU work and live Destroy cannot skip the completion fence.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered bookkeeping HEAD 9984491d78dc8dc11504c94fbb84e3cf10e965a2 after CONVERSION-DX9EX-00468 final exact-SHA PASS. Post-1100 structural extraction remains terminal and ARCH-V3-GATE-001 remains HMD-gated.

C1_REVIEW.evidence: R19 RenderTo marks gpuWorkSubmitted only when a Swapchain* owner is supplied. R19 native projection/theater paths already pass &Projection/&Theater and R24 emergency clear explicitly marks its owner, but R24 RenderSafeProjectionChecked and RenderDirectFlatFallback called RenderTo with the default null owner. Their Draw commands therefore referenced OpenXR RTVs without activating the destroy completion fence.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Added &Projection to R24 per-eye direct projection RenderTo and &Theater to direct-flat RenderTo. Added deterministic verifier coverage requiring both owner arguments while retaining explicit release-content provenance.

evidence.spec_basis: OpenXR 1.1.63 requires submitted graphics commands that refer to a swapchain to complete before xrDestroySwapchain. R19's bounded event-query drain is gated by per-swapchain gpuWorkSubmitted provenance.
code_review: RenderTo already owns the single post-Draw NoteGpuWorkSubmitted hook when swapchainOwner is non-null.
R19 projection/theater paths pass the owner; R24 final projection/direct-flat paths did not.
R24 emergency ClearRenderTargetView has explicit owner provenance from CONVERSION-DX9EX-00467.
